name: Accordion
description: A stacked set of headings that reveal or hide related content.

name: Alert
description: Inline status messages and a blocking confirmation variant for consequential actions.

name: Aspect Ratio
description: A media container that preserves a chosen width-to-height ratio.

name: Attachment
description: File metadata, status, and actions presented as one compact object.

name: Autocomplete
description: A text field that filters suggestions while allowing a free-form value.

name: Avatar
description: A compact person or organization identity with an accessible text fallback.

name: Badge
description: Short labels for categories, counts, and meaningful status states.

name: Breadcrumb
description: A hierarchical trail that locates the current page within an application.

name: Button
description: Action controls in primary, secondary, ghost, destructive, busy, and disabled states.

name: Button Group
description: Related actions joined into one compact control group.

name: Calendar
description: A keyboard-navigable month grid for choosing a date.

name: Card
description: A bordered surface with optional header, content, and action regions.

name: Carousel
description: A finite sequence of panels with previous, next, and keyboard navigation.

name: Chart
description: A responsive data visualization paired with a text summary and source table.

name: Checkbox
description: A binary option with checked, unchecked, disabled, and invalid states.

name: Checkbox Group
description: A labelled set of related checkboxes with select-all and mixed-state feedback.

name: Collapsible
description: A single trigger that expands or collapses one content region.

name: Combobox
description: A text input that filters and commits one value from a controlled option set.

name: Command
description: A searchable command palette with grouped keyboard-selectable actions.

name: Data Table
description: A sortable, filterable table that adapts to narrow screens without losing semantics.

name: Date Picker
description: A date field paired with a constrained calendar popover.

name: Dialog
description: A modal task surface with focus containment, validation, dismissal, and focus restoration.

name: Diff
description: An adjustable before-and-after comparison with an accessible position value.

name: Drawer
description: A modal panel that enters from a viewport edge for secondary tasks.

name: Dropdown Menu
description: A button-triggered menu with roving focus, checked options, and keyboard typeahead.

name: Empty
description: A clear zero-state with explanation and a relevant next action.

name: Field
description: A label, control, description, and validation message composed as one field.

name: Fieldset
description: A semantic grouping for related controls with a shared legend.

name: File Input
description: A native file picker with selection feedback and supported-format guidance.

name: Hover Card
description: Supplementary information shown from hover or keyboard focus without blocking the page.

name: Input
description: Single-line text fields across default, disabled, and invalid states.

name: Input Group
description: A text field combined with icons, prefixes, or adjacent actions.

name: Input OTP
description: A multi-slot one-time-code input with paste and automatic focus handling.

name: Item
description: A reusable row for metadata, leading content, and trailing actions.

name: Kbd
description: Keyboard shortcuts and individual key labels rendered inline.

name: Label
description: Accessible labels with optional required and supplementary information.

name: Lightbox
description: A modal media viewer with thumbnail selection, next and previous controls, and arrow-key navigation.

name: Marker
description: Small semantic indicators for neutral and status-coded states.

name: Message
description: A structured message with author, timestamp, body, and optional status.

name: Message Scroller
description: A live message region that preserves reading position and offers a jump-to-latest action.

name: Meter
description: A bounded scalar measurement with optimum, warning, and critical states.

name: Native Select
description: The platform select element styled for consistent application forms.

name: Navigation Menu
description: Primary navigation with keyboard-accessible grouped destination panels.

name: Number Field
description: A bounded numeric input with explicit increment and decrement actions.

name: Pagination
description: Page navigation with current-page context and previous or next controls.

name: Popover
description: A non-modal overlapping surface positioned relative to a trigger.

name: Progress
description: Task completion represented with native determinate and indeterminate states.

name: Questionnaire
description: A progressively enhanced multi-step form with native no-script fallback.

name: Radio Group
description: A mutually exclusive set of labelled choices.

name: Rating
description: A keyboard-accessible ordinal rating built from native radio controls.

name: Resizable
description: Adjacent panels separated by a pointer- and keyboard-operable resize handle.

name: Scroll Area
description: A bounded overflow region that retains native scrolling behavior.

name: Select
description: A custom single-value picker with full keyboard navigation and a hidden form value.

name: Separator
description: A semantic visual divider for horizontal or vertical content groups.

name: Sheet
description: A modal side surface for focused forms and detail views.

name: Sidebar
description: A collapsible application sidebar with grouped destinations and shortcut support.

name: Skeleton
description: A reserved-content placeholder used while data is loading.

name: Slider
description: A native range input with visible and accessible value feedback.

name: Sortable List
description: A reorderable list with drag-and-drop plus complete keyboard controls and announcements.

name: Spinner
description: A compact indeterminate activity indicator with accessible status text.

name: Split Button
description: A primary action paired with a menu of closely related alternatives.

name: Stat
description: A compact metric with label, value, and supporting change context.

name: Steps
description: A linear progress indicator for completed, current, and upcoming stages.

name: Switch
description: An immediate on-or-off preference control with disabled and invalid states.

name: Table
description: A semantic table for structured data without sorting or filtering behavior.

name: Tabs
description: A roving-focus tab list that switches among related content panels.

name: Textarea
description: A resizable multi-line text field with description and validation states.

name: Time Field
description: A segmented hour, minute, and period field with cyclic keyboard stepping and a form-ready value.

name: Timeline
description: Chronological events connected by state-aware markers.

name: Toast
description: A transient live-region notification with an explicit dismiss action.

name: Toggle
description: A two-state button that exposes its pressed state.

name: Toggle Group
description: A single- or multi-select collection of pressed-state buttons.

name: Toolbar
description: A roving-focus collection of related controls and toggle groups.

name: Tooltip
description: A concise accessible description shown from hover or focus.

name: Typography
description: The supported body, heading, quotation, list, and inline text treatments.
